name: Ten Bamboo Studio polychrome block print
summary: Hu Zhengyan's workshop cut many small blocks for one picture (douban) and printed them in turn on one sheet. Dry blocks pressed the paper (gonghua) and raised the outline of a petal or a cloud.

philosophy.core_thesis: A page of a painting manual can carry the soft colour of a scroll when the printer splits the picture into small blocks that fit like a jigsaw.
design_principles: Split each picture by colour into small blocks, up to dozens for one page, and print them one by one on the same sheet.
Grade the ink on one block (a wet-brush effect) so one petal or leaf shades from pale to deep.
Print the key outline in light ink, with a thin line, and let the colour carry the form.
Press a dry block into the sheet (gonghua) to raise the outline of a petal, a cloud or a wave, with no ink on it.
Choose a quiet subject of the literati: a plum, bamboo, a rock, a bird or an orchid.
Use pale, clear colours: rose, moss green, water blue and ink grey.
Add a short poem in calligraphy and a red seal.
anti_patterns: A heavy black outline in the manner of a folk print
Poster colours that are loud and opaque
A large flat area of one colour with no gradation

process.matrix: Pearwood blocks, cut small, up to dozens for one image, and dry blocks for the embossed lines.
process.press: No press. A printer rubs the back of the sheet with a pad by hand.
process.image_making: A painter makes the design. A carver splits it by colour into jigsaw blocks, and a printer sets them in order.
process.edition: Book editions, in sets of albums.

inks.strategy: Water-based colour and ink on small blocks, with graded ink on a single block. The outline prints in pale ink, then the colour blocks, then the dry emboss.

screening.rule: Make a tone with a graded wash of ink on one block, with a soft edge of about 5–20 mm. The style has no screen.

registration.rule: The small blocks must fit within 0.4 mm. The jigsaw join shows only as a hair line of white.

substrate.stock: Thin xuan-type paper of bark and straw fibre.
substrate.finish: Soft and absorbent, so the ink sinks in and the paper takes the emboss.

surface.impression: Medium. The dry blocks raise the outline by 0.1–0.3 mm.
surface.sheen: Matt. The raised lines show only in raking light.
surface.texture: Soft colour with a feathered edge, a raised line without ink, and a fine paper fibre.

marks: feathered ink gradation on one block
colour blocks fitted like a jigsaw

emotion.target_response: A quiet delight in small, true things: the viewer sees a flower that seems to have been painted by a brush.

use_cases: gift cards with a blind emboss
avoid_when: The brief needs a loud, flat folk colour set.
The picture needs a heavy, dark outline.

modifiers.how: Thicken the key line to 1–2 mm, use flat vermilion and green, and drop the gradation and the emboss.
Keep the colour blocks. Print on washi with bokashi, and add a firm sumi key line.
